provenance.note: `remove_entry` shelves the club stamped `now`, and answers None without writing for an empty slot or no bag; `restore_entry` copies the slot's newest stint back, freshly stamped, and leaves the stint on the append-only shelf, so out and back is two stints; None for a slot that never held another or no bag. A restore whose stint is the club already in the slot is `set_entry`'s same-club case: untouched and not written (`test_removing_a_club_shelves_it` and the restore tests after it)
